title: fix(approvals): RESUME_FAILED carries the refusal that stranded the run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Pe4kChjRUAqJ91tVGSLW5b)_

Fixes #34579

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #34637

## 维护者速读

- 现象：审批通过后，下一步「改记录」被记录钩子拒绝，接口回 500 RESUME_FAILED，审批人看不到被拒原因，流程卡住。
- 改了什么：状态码按 #13807 裁决仍是 500，决定照旧记下；错误体新增 `innerRefusal`（拒绝码和原文）和 `userMessage`（钩子声明的、按调用者语言的那句话），审批人能看到为什么。
- 流程作者在这一步画一条 fault 边，拒绝就走 fault 分支（比如退回给销售），审批正常返回，流程不卡；这条行为已钉测并写进审批文档。
- 没碰的：不先试跑、不回滚决定（#13807 B、#13937 形态 4 两条裁决不动）；钩子没拒绝而是崩溃时，两个新字段都不出现。
- 契约面：`@objectstack/types` 的 `StrandedDecisionDetails` 加两个可选成员，属放宽，需契约复审。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What changes

The card's preferred route (dry-run the post-decision step and keep the request pending) conflicts with ruling #13807 B and the #13937 shape-4 ruling. Per the seat's premise correction (comment 6936860860), this PR ships the fallback inside those rulings.

- **`@objectstack/types` — `StrandedDecisionDetails`** gains two optional members:
  - `innerRefusal?: FlowInnerRefusal` — the engine's `AutomationResult.innerRefusal` (ruling B′ on #24914), the same member every flow door serves in `FLOW_FAILED` details;
  - `userMessage?: string` — the refusal's producer-marked end-user text (the engine's `AutomationResult.userMessage`).

  `strandedDecisionDetails` validates both (`ErrorCode` for the code, `declaredUserMessage` for the text) and **drops** a malformed one while keeping the four #13807 facts. The four facts stay all-or-nothing; a refusal member never rescues a partial envelope.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`** — `serviceResume` keeps the engine's `innerRefusal` / `userMessage` beside `resumeCode` / `resumeStatus` instead of dropping them, and `resumeRecordedOutcome` attaches them to the stranded-decision envelope. Every decision door that resumes through `resumeRecordedOutcome` (approve, reject, revise, resubmit, the restored-run continuation) carries them.
- **`@objectstack/rest`** — no logic change: `handleApprovalError` already spreads the recognised envelope into the `RESUME_FAILED` body, so both members reach the wire at the top level. Comment updated.
- **`@objectstack/spec`** — `ApprovalDecisionResult.resumed` docblock (`contracts/approval-service.ts`) names the two members and the `fault`-edge route. Comment only; no schema or generated artifact moves.
- **Docs** — `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` gains a callout: what the 500 body carries when the step after the decision is refused, and how a `fault` edge on that step handles it instead.

### Why `userMessage` as well as `innerRefusal`

Measured, not assumed: for a hook that declares a `refusals` catalogue, the runtime's `SandboxError` keeps the diagnostic `hook '<name>' threw: …` as `.message` and puts the declared, localized sentence on `.userMessage` (`resolveHookRefusal` / `resolveInProcessHookRefusal`, `runtime/src/sandbox/hook-refusal-catalogue.ts`). `refusalCarriedBy` builds `innerRefusal.message` from `.message`, so `innerRefusal` alone does not give the approver the hook's readable sentence. The flow doors serve the same pair (details `innerRefusal` + top-level `userMessage`, `flow-dispatch-status.ts`), so this reuses that vocabulary and adds none.

## Why

The engine already reported the refusal on the stranded exit (`run-resume.ts`, `...readCarriedRefusal(err)`), and the approvals door dropped it one line before building the envelope, the same place #13807 found `status` being dropped.

## Verification

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/hook-refusal-after-decision.test.ts` (new): the card's flow end to end with a real `AutomationEngine`, the real `update_record` node and approval node, and a data double that throws a declared hook refusal in the runtime's shape.
  1. No fault edge: still `RESUME_FAILED`, decision `approved`, plan still `submitted`, and `strandedDecisionDetails(err)` equals the four facts plus `innerRefusal: { code: 'VALIDATION_FAILED', message }` and the hook's `userMessage`.
  2. A `fault` edge on the step: the refusal is routed to the handler, `decide` answers `finalized: true, resumed: true`, nothing left parked. (Pins existing engine behaviour; green before and after the fix.)
  3. Reverse control: a step that faults (no declared status) carries neither member.
  - Ablation: with `approval-service.ts` reverted to `origin/main`, case 1 goes red (`expected { finalized: true, …(3) } to deeply equal { finalized: true, …(5) }`); cases 2 and 3 stay green.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-approvals-wire-codes.test.ts`: new case — the 500 body carries `innerRefusal` and `userMessage` at the top level, exact key set pinned. The existing #13807 exact-key-set pins are unchanged and still green.
- `packages/types/src/stranded-decision.test.ts`: round-trip, malformed members dropped with the four facts kept, and a refusal member never rescues a partial envelope. The existing "exactly the four declared keys" pin is unchanged and still green.
- Derived gates at head `95eae72668321d7f8eb2233f80753911e1202288`: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 125; all 125 exit 0; `--ran` reconcile: 125 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Package suites: `plugin-approvals` 122 files / 1723 tests, `types` 40 / 923, `rest` 419 / 8865 (373 skipped), all green; `typecheck` green for `types`, `plugin-approvals` and `rest`. The second commit only touches the two new/edited test files (an unused `findOne` dropped from the new double for `check:engine-double-contract`, and a module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql'` for `check:test-source-alias`) plus `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`; both test files re-ran green on the final head.
- `git merge-tree` at the final head: clean against `origin/main` (97defd6067), #34545 (df9ac15c59) and #34592 (a6661f57e8).

No existing test was changed to accommodate the fix.
